title: Functorial gluing of scheme descent data as locally represented sheaves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\{T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ a set-indexed fppf covering of its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. Work in the universes and small site skeletons of [def-weil-size-convention]. All fibre products are over $T$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $h_Z(W)=\operatorname{Mor}_T(W,Z)$, and let $\mathcal L$ be the full category of sheaves of sets $H$ on this site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] for which each $h_{T_i}\times H$ is represented by a scheme. Let $\mathcal D$ be the category of scheme descent data on the covering [def-trf-scheme-cover-descent-datum]: objects are schemes $X_i/T_i$ and isomorphisms $\phi_{ij}:X_i\times_TT_j\simeq T_i\times_TX_j$ over $T_i\times_TT_j$ satisfying the triple cocycle; morphisms are compatible families of $T_i$-maps. Restrictions to slices are sectionwise [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. There exist a functor $G:\mathcal D\to\mathcal L$ and isomorphisms $e_{D,i}:G(D)|_{T_i}\simeq F_{D,i}$, where $F_{D,i}(W\to T_i)=\operatorname{Mor}_{T_i}(W,X_i)$ for $D=(X_i,\phi_{ij})$. On $W\to T_i\times_TT_j$ let $\theta_{D,ij}$ take a map to $X_i$ to the map to $X_j$ induced by $\phi_{ij}$ with the prescribed base coordinates. Then $e_{D,j}=\theta_{D,ij}e_{D,i}$ on double slices. For each morphism $f:D\to D'$ with components $f_i$, the maps satisfy $e_{D',i}\circ G(f)|_{T_i}=h_{f_i}\circ e_{D,i}$. For every $W/T$, the inverse slice bijections $e_{D,i}^{-1}$ give natural representations $\beta_{D,i}:h_{X_i}\simeq h_{T_i}\times G(D)$ by separating maps $W\to X_i$ according to their composite $W\to T_i$. Under these representations the overlap comparison preserving the $G(D)$ coordinate is exactly $\phi_{ij}$. For any functor $R:\mathcal L\to\mathcal D$ defined by choosing product representations and the coordinate-preserving overlap comparisons, with morphisms representing $\mathrm{id}\times v$, the comparisons between its chosen representatives of $G(D)$ and the representations $\beta_{D,i}$ induce a natural isomorphism $\epsilon:R\circ G\simeq\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$.

proof.text: Use the sheaf descent datum already stored in SchemeCoverDescentDatum.data; its local objects are sheaves and its transitions already satisfy the cocycle. The fppf covering generates a covering sieve. Apply lem-pe-set-sheaf-cover-descent to obtain essential-image membership of every such datum and full faithfulness of restriction to descent data. Mathlib Functor.essImage.liftFunctor and liftFunctorCompIso then lift schemeCoverDescentForget to a global-sheaf functor G0 with natural comparison e0: G0 followed by restriction is isomorphic to forget. This uses no new choice of a scheme or representability assertion.

proof.text: For each D and i, evaluate e0 at i and forget to presheaves. Transport D.representation i along the inverse isomorphism. The resulting representation r identifies the restriction of G0(D) with the same specified local scheme. Hence G0(D) satisfies IsLocallyRepresentableFppfSheaf. Lift G0 through that full subcategory and use the associator and liftCompιIso to construct e. The two functor-lifting constructions are packaged by proved private existential helper theorems to keep their choices abstract during kernel checking; after the second lift, transport the local representations directly along e.

proof.text: Construct the product representation explicitly. For a T-map x:V→X with X over Ui, put W=(V,x followed by X→Ui); send x to its composite V→Ui paired with the section obtained from r.homEquiv x on W, transported along the canonical identity-underlying isomorphism V≅(Over.map fi)(W). Conversely take a pair (a,s), use W=(V,a), restrict s along the inverse identity-underlying map, and apply r.homEquiv.symm. The Over triangle equations and the two equivalence inverse identities prove these maps inverse. For a map g:V→Vprime the canonical map between these W objects has underlying g; r.homEquiv_comp and H.map_comp prove naturality. This gives a representation of the explicit product functor, transported through Mathlib FunctorToTypes.binaryProductIso to the categorical product β.

source.place: Tag 02W5, lemma-descent-data-sheaves, left-to-right construction and local comparison; Sites Tags 04TR, lemma-glue-sheaves, and 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps.

proof.text: For x:W→X over Ui, its structure composite equals W.hom by Over.w. In the preceding construction the canonical map between W and the object defined by x followed by X→Ui has identity underlying arrow. Naturality of r and H.map_id show that the second coordinate is exactly r.homEquiv x. Mathlib binaryProductIso_inv_comp_fst_apply and binaryProductIso_inv_comp_snd_apply give the requested projection equations; the definition of r gives the stated inverse-e component. Transition compatibility is already carried by e, so these are also the prescribed overlap comparisons.

source.place: Tag 02W5, lemma-descent-data-sheaves, left-to-right construction and local comparison; Sites Tags 04TR, lemma-glue-sheaves, and 04TQ, lemma-glue-maps.

proof.text: Given R,rR, compose the associator, the left whiskering of rR by G, e, and the inverse left unitor to obtain (G⋙R)⋙forget ≅ Id⋙forget. The forgetful functor is the fully faithful inducedFunctor, so Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight gives ε:G⋙R≅Id. Its hom is the preimage of the displayed composite; map_preimage followed by evaluating at i proves the exact requested component equation. All constructions are uniform in empty or repeated covering indices and require no nonempty section set.
